prompt:
Update the existing section sections/lookbook-grid.liquid. Keep the {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Only the markup above it should change. Inputs. There are no top-level variables other than `section`. - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.max_looks: integer >= 1, or null. null means 6. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block has `type` (string, e.g. "look" or "spacer") and `settings`. Every block, of any type, has settings.title (string or null), settings.caption (string or null) and settings.hidden (boolean). Eligible look: a block is eligible only when all of these hold: - its type is exactly "look"; - settings.hidden is not true; - settings.title, after stripping leading and trailing whitespace, is non-empty (null counts as empty). All other blocks are skipped entirely. Output. Produce no whitespace between tags. 1. Wrapper: `

`. 2. Heading: if heading, stripped, is non-empty, output `

HEADING

` first inside the wrapper. HEADING is the stripped heading, HTML-escaped. Otherwise there is no h2. 3. No eligible looks: if there are zero eligible looks, output `

No looks yet

` after the optional heading. Output nothing else (no ul). 4. Otherwise, output `
    ` ... `
`. It contains the first max_looks eligible looks, in block order. The limit counts only eligible looks, never skipped blocks. - Each look is `
    • `. - NN is the look's 1-based position among the rendered looks. It is zero-padded to two digits only when below 10 (01 ... 09, then 10, 11, ...). - TITLE is the stripped title, HTML-escaped. - CAPTION is `CAPTION_TEXT` when the caption, stripped, is non-empty. CAPTION_TEXT is the stripped, escaped caption. Otherwise CAPTION is empty. 5. More notice: after ``, compute REST = (number of eligible looks) - (number rendered). If REST > 0, output `

    +REST more looks

    `. Use the singular `look` instead of `looks` when REST is exactly 1. HTML-escape with the standard escape filter, which escapes & < > " and '. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/lookbook-grid.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
